svg.title: Wireframe 3: add lifter form on a phone
svg.desc: Three greyscale states of the add lifter form at 375 px width: name suggestions open, a filled form with the 4 and 8 percent preview for both lifts, and the form with validation errors.
svg.text: Wireframe 3 · Add lifter · phone (375 px)
Opens from the group board (Add lifter) and works before and during the competition. Greyscale layout only: colours, fonts and icons are placeholders. Names and numbers are made up.
A
Name with suggestions

g.text: Club, if not SK Atlas optional
Attempts 2 and 3 are filled in for you
Fill in both openings to see attempts 2 and 3.

svg.text: Typing searches this club's lifter directory only.
Picking a suggestion fills in sex, birth year and club.
The last option adds a new lifter. Sex and birth year
are then required. The birth year in each suggestion
tells apart two lifters with the same name.
B
Filled in

g.text: Club, if not SK Atlas optional
Attempts 2 and 3 are filled in for you
+4 % and +8 %, whole kg. Dashed = estimate, edit on the board.

svg.text: Required fields have a *. Bodyweight and club are optional
(the weigh-in often comes later and can be added on the board).
Both openings are required, so all six attempts exist at once.
The preview shows attempts 2 and 3 (+4 % and +8 %, whole kg,
at least +1 kg). Dashed = estimate. Next free lot is suggested.
C
Validation errors

g.text: Fix 4 fields to add the lifter
Club, if not SK Atlas optional
Lot 3 is used by Anna Berg
Attempts 2 and 3 are filled in for you
Fill in both openings to see attempts 2 and 3.

svg.text: Checked when Add lifter is pressed. The summary names how
many fields need fixing and the first one gets focus.
Every message is next to its field, says what to do and is
linked to the input for screen readers. Lot numbers must be
unique inside the group.
